svg.text: EchoSphere — Complete System Architecture
Multi-tenant voice-AI platform · verified from source at ea4750c24 (25 Aug 2026) · two Python planes over one shared library + React console · ~150k LOC app code
Web Console — React 18 SPA
super-admin console + tenant Studio · Vite dev :5199 · 40 pages
strict TS contract (159 types) · role/permission-gated affordances
MCP Clients
external LLM agents · streamable HTTP
platform JWT · 60 req/min/tenant
PSTN Callers — Vaani dialer (eDAS) · FreeSWITCH PBX
signed webhook (HMAC + replay SETNX) → per-call minted media WS URL
media: Vaani JSON 8 kHz · FS mod_audio_fork 16 kHz / mod_audio_stream 8 kHz
WhatsApp (Meta Cloud API)
per-channel inbound webhook, HMAC-verified
(messaging pipeline itself not implemented)
HTTPS /api/v1
WS raw PCM → :9002 (Studio live voice test)
webhook + media WS → :9011
channel webhook → API :9001
CONTROL PLANE — backend/ (28.4k LOC)
Platform API — FastAPI · 33 routers · 208 endpoints
every endpoint auth-guarded · {success, data, meta} envelope · 8 exception handlers · camelCase serializers (1,055 lines)
unauthenticated surface: /auth/login + signed webhooks only · docs at /api/docs
HTTP :9001

g.text: /testing/chat runs the REAL router + workflow engine + guardrails
+ compliance wordings · runtime simulator with mock tools
4 read-only knowledge tools · identity from verified JWT only
rate limit + 20 s tool timeout · every call audited
polls PG ingestion_jobs every 2 s · FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
parse → chunk → embed → index → verify probe · 3 attempts

svg.text: Boot (lifespan): optional migrations · Mongo connect + indexes · idempotent base seed (ON by default) · embedded worker task
No service layer — routers own business logic, aggregates and audit calls. Soft delete everywhere; hard delete env-gated.
Publish pipeline — the config lifecycle
draft → review → approved → published → rolled_back · publish re-computes a 6-item checklist from real state and hard-blocks on gaps
on publish/rollback: bot version fields stamped + Redis botcfg:* invalidated — new calls see the release, live calls keep their pinned snapshot
voice / WhatsApp / SMS channels activate only on a published bot · phone numbers assigned per bot route real traffic
REALTIME VOICE PLANE — voice_runtime/ (14.7k LOC)
One FastAPI app · two processes
voice worker :9002 (browser sessions) · telephony gateway :9011 (public bind, runtime preloaded for dialer handshakes)
sessions minted ONLY by the control plane / signed webhook → consumed from Redis · tenant mismatch ⇒ WS close 4403
Pipecat 1.5 pipeline — one per call, config pinned at start
transport.input → CallerAudioGate (dBFS floor) → Silero VAD → STT (Sarvam WS · Deepgram Flux · segmented REST)
→ UserTurnProcessor (word-confirmed barge-in · adaptive endpoints 0.35/0.12 s · Flux owns EOT) → ConversationBrain
→ StreamingTTSRouter (Sarvam/ElevenLabs WS · fallback on transient errors · 4 s first-audio watchdog) → transport.output
+ stereo AudioBufferProcessor after output — the recording is exactly what was played
ConversationBrain — per-turn orchestration (brain.py 4,482 · call_policy.py 2,452)
transcript quality gate → deterministic router (hangup/DNC/emergency · intent match-strength) → guardrail input check
→ Goal Engine decision (gpt-4o-mini · 1.2 s / 200 tok · scope rules strip unauthorized tools/slots) → route:
workflow step (LangGraph → PG checkpoints) · RAG retrieve (speculative prefetch) · SSRF-guarded tool call · direct/streamed reply
→ sentence-held guardrail check (violating sentence never spoken) · naturalness planner · per-turn hi/en voice switching
collections domain policy: identity confirm · txn-reference capture · strict recovery ladder

g.text: killAudio on barge-in · first-packet ramp (~160 ms saved)
normalize_disconnect verdicts · uuid_kill on bot end
→ next call: memory greeting + language continuity
Mongo transcript + events · MySQL conversation row
stereo WAV closed · guardrail ledger persisted

svg.text: Latency budgets (constants in code): decision 1.2 s / 200 tok · LLM first token 3 s · TTS first audio 4 s · endpoint 0.35 / 0.12 s
pause-flush 0.6 s · barge-in ≥2 words or 1 s VAD · speculative decision + KB prefetch · per-turn latency attribution
no direct
imports
both planes import ONLY shared/
SHARED LIBRARY — shared/ (28.1k LOC): the single meeting point of both planes

g.text: auth · tenancy · bots · content · context · billing · ops
goal engine · decision schema · deterministic router
LangGraph workflow interpreter · naturalness · prompt compiler
tenant/bot authorization · chunk review · injection scan
STT: whisper · deepgram · sarvam · assemblyai · mock
TTS: sarvam/11L WS + REST · LLM: openai/anthropic/google
native-currency FX → USD · never fabricates a rate · mock unbilled
mandatory floor (PII · secrets · unsafe tools · injection) FAILS CLOSED
versioned policies: calling windows · contact limits · exact wordings
Redis snapshot TTL 300 s, invalidated on publish · session handoff
HMAC verify · replay SETNX · DID routing · compliance gate
SSRF guard: public-IP DNS check · no redirects · response caps

svg.text: also: config.py (.env → Settings, secret references env:/secret://, fail-fast per service) · secrets.py · logging_utils (mandatory log redaction) · readiness.py · turn_detection.py · runtime_context.py · post_call/ (analyzer · NBA · recall)
import rule: backend → shared ← voice_runtime (4 documented breaches) · caveat: shared/errors.py imports FastAPI, so the web stack reaches every process
Frontend contract: src/services/api.ts (186 typed functions) mirrors backend/serializers.py by hand — single envelope-aware fetch wrapper, 401 ⇒ token cleared + redirect to /login.
persistence (single host, ports from .env)

svg.text: CROSS-CUTTING GUARANTEES & OPERATIONAL REALITY

g.text: JWT HS256 (12 h) · role + permissions re-read from DB per request
password_changed_at revokes older tokens · tenant identity never
from the client · cross-tenant by-id ⇒ 404 (existence hidden)
row-level scoping on shared infra · costs.view financial gate
guardrails fail CLOSED to a mandatory floor · compliance policies
and Redis controls fail OPEN (documented trade) · sentence-hold
output blocking · tools denied in any turn a guardrail fired
call admission: outbound-block · calling windows · contact limits
every billable op → one idempotent usage_event with a pricing
snapshot · insert-only price history · INR-native FX → USD
mock providers never billed · 147 audit call sites, masked values,
same-transaction writes · per-call cost breakdown APIs
scripts/dev.sh supervises 6 processes on ONE Linux host
no containers · no CI · no TLS · no reverse proxy · binds 0.0.0.0
stores locally installed · migrations: cli migrate / pg-migrate
seed-on-boot ON · workers embedded · scale limits per-process
Top verified risks (of 40 in the register, §24 of the reference document)
no API rate limiting or login lockout · JWT + session in localStorage · per-process voice admission guards
real call recordings tracked in git · compliance fail-open vs guardrail fail-closed asymmetry
dead transport-serializer branches · mod_audio_stream transfer-flag bug · MySQL↔PG knowledge drift (manual audit)
remediation priorities: Now / Next / Later in §25
1 SPA REST · 2 SPA live-voice WS · 3 MCP tools · 4 dialer webhook + media · 5 WhatsApp webhook
6 planes → shared library · 7 shared → four stores + disk · 8 runtime/API → external providers
session handoff: API mints voice:session:{id} in Redis → runtime consumes; config pinned per call
